name: glyph-field
description: 鼠标驱动的字体权重热力场
tagline: Where your cursor shapes every letter.
interaction: As the mouse moves across a canvas of glyphs, each character's font-weight dynamically shifts based on proximity to the cursor, creating a radiant heatmap of typographic density. The field ripples and breathes in real-time — closer letters grow bold and heavy while distant ones remain ghost-thin, turning static text into a living, cursor-reactive topography.
